messages:
anita: heads-up — embedding quality regression on v3.0.0 surfaced in canary for dedicated pools (semantic-similarity drift ~12%). latency up ~30ms p95. deploy-bot shows hosted ok, dedicated flagged. auto-rollback is disabled for dedicated. should we do a targeted unwind for dedicated-only?

deploy-bot: signal summary: region=usw2, cohort=dedicated, semantic_delta=12.1%, p95_delta=+30ms, window=9m. suggestion: `--targeted-traffic-slice` rollback to v2.9.4 for dedicated pools. sample command: `/deploy rollback --to v2.9.4 --cohort=dedicated --regions=usw2 --slice=30% --pin=15m`
omar: I'm +1 for targeted unwind. customers on dedicated SLAs (acct:govtech) already flagged. we can't touch hosted since too many experiments are running. prefer a staged 30%->60%->100% with 2m waits and smoke tests. also note: change window ends at 18:00 UTC; we need to finish before that.
kate: agree. I'll own the rollout and comms. plan: 1) announce to account reps, 2) run rollback slice 30% for 2m, run eval harness (embedding-sanity, p95), 3) escalate to 60% if green, 4) pin v2.9.4 for 15m and monitor. I'll draft the release-note blurb: "Targeted rollback to v2.9.4 for Dedicated pools due to embedding regression in canary; hosted remains on v3.0.0."
release-comms-bot: creating incident note draft and adding timeline template. ticket: INF-3247. will post account-facing short note to #customer-notify after confirmation.
anita: ok @deploy-bot run the targeted slice rollback. include `--preserve-sessions` and `--warm-kv` flags to reduce cold-start noise.
deploy-bot: executing: ```
/deploy rollback --to v2.9.4 --cohort=dedicated --regions=usw2 --slice=30% --pin=15m --preserve-sessions=true --warm-kv=5m
```
estimated: 90s. will report back with health checks.
deploy-bot: slice at 30% complete. health: embedding_delta down to 3.2%, p95 baseline, error_rate stable. proceeding only on explicit approve to move to 60%.
omar: approve move to 60% — go slow but proceed. kate: kicking to 60% now.
deploy-bot: updating slice to 60% (graceful drain 45s).
deploy-bot: 60% slice complete. health checks pass. embedding_delta ~1.1%, p95 stable. preparing final 100%.
kate: final 100% slice in 1m. reminder: we'll pin for 15m, run embed-suite + smoke queries, and send account note.
deploy-bot: rollback to v2.9.4 for dedicated pools completed. traffic pinned. KV warm period active.
anita: thanks team. kate — please push the short note to release-comms and ping GovTech and finance contacts. include link to INF-3247 and mention we limited scope to dedicated pools.
kate: posted to #release-comms and DM'd account reps. release-note blurb: "Targeted rollback: Dedicated pool rollback to v2.9.4 due to embedding drift in canary. Hosted remains on v3.0.0. Monitoring in progress."
omar: creating follow-up action items: add dedicated rollback automation flag to allow quick targeted rollbacks (so less manual ops next time) and add regression eval to pre-canary gates. adding to INF-3247.
anita: good. will add RCA owner and timeline to the ticket. closing this thread for coordination; will follow up in INF-3247. :lock:
